claims.note: Ministerial approval by the Community Development Director on 2026-11-18, effective immediately
SB 1123 Starter Home Revitalization Act zoning clearance and tentative map under Interim Ordinance No. 2334; CEQA exempt as ministerial
City found the project not subject to inclusionary housing because the preliminary application predated the expansion to 5+ unit projects

construction_notes.text: Site at the southeast corner of Budd Avenue and Emory Avenue; zoned R-1-8, Low Density Residential, San Tomas Area Neighborhood Plan. Subdivides the parcel into five lots.

The site holds an existing single-family house; Demolition Permit BLD-2026-1410 authorizes whole-house demolition, required before final map recordation or building permit issuance. Net increase of four units.

The city found the parcel was not vacant at submittal but applied Interim Ordinance No. 2334, Section 4.C, in effect when the preliminary application was filed. The approval cites HCD's July 17, 2026 technical assistance letter stating that the vacancy requirement should be met at application submittal, and imposes an indemnification condition.
Each unit is two stories with an attached one-car garage; modern style with white stucco, wood siding and flat roofs.

A separate 2025 city application, PLN-2025-26 (applicant listed as Liu, filed 2025-02-25), proposed splitting the parcel into two lots, keeping the existing house and adding one new house; city data shows it as Under Review.
